_about: Shadowspire Citadel (levels 47-55): stalkers, mirror wraiths, void walkers and nightmare beasts answer each other in the dark, the nightmare beasts are elites, and Shadow Lord Malachar on the Throne of Shadows drowns the hall in darkness and splits off shadow stalkers.

797450.name: mirror malachar shadow reflection
797450.long_desc: The Mirror of Malachar sits upon the inverted throne, a perfect reversed copy of the Shadow Lord.
797450.description: It is Shadow Lord Malachar in every line, but reversed, as in a glass: the scar on the wrong cheek, the rings on the wrong hand. Perhaps it is the copy. Perhaps it is not. It speaks a moment after you do, in your own voice.
